components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: linear-gradient(to right, #3b82f6, #8b5cf6); padding: 12px 24px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: #e2e8f0; border: none; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(139,92,246,0.25); transition: box-shadow 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), transform 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); font-family: inherit; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 20px 25px -5px rgba(139,92,246,0.45); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #0a0a0f, 0 0 0 4px #8b5cf6; }

components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; border-radius: 1rem; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10); background: rgba(22,24,31,0.75); padding: 28px; transition: border-color 300ms, background 300ms, box-shadow 300ms; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.20); background: rgba(22,24,31,0.90); box-shadow: 0 20px 25px -5px rgba(139,92,246,0.05); } .ds-card-title { font-family: "Space Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; color: #e2e8f0; margin: 0 0 8px; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-card-body { font-family: "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #cbd5e1; line-height: 1.6; margin: 0; }

components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; } .ds-label { font-family: "JetBrains Mono", monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 400; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.3em; color: #9ca3af; } .ds-input { width: 100%; border-radius: 0.5rem; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); padding: 10px 16px; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #e2e8f0; font-family: "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif; outline: none; transition: border-color 200ms, box-shadow 200ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6b7280; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: rgba(139,92,246,0.50); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(139,92,246,0.30); }

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 32px; align-items: center; } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; padding-bottom: 2px; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #cbd5e1; text-decoration: none; transition: color 200ms; } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; width: 0; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #60a5fa, #a78bfa); transition: width 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #e2e8f0; } .ds-nav-link:hover::after, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible::after { width: 100%; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: none; color: #e2e8f0; }

narrative.overview:
This system is built for a specific human moment: a recruiter or founder opens the page and decides, within 60 seconds, whether to reach out. The design cannot shout. It has to feel like a person is already in the room — present, warm, no performance anxiety. The typography leads. The spacing breathes. The color exists to orient, not impress.

The current implementation (dark ink backgrounds, violet/azure accent split) is a documented baseline captured before a deliberate palette rethink. The north star and component character are the fixed points; the palette is the active variable.
keyCharacteristics: Typographic hierarchy carries the page; color is secondary
Generous spacing at section level (128px between sections), tighter inside components
Pill-shaped interactive elements — friendly, not corporate
Cards are solid dark panels, not glass
Motion is respectful: prefers-reduced-motion guarded throughout
Keyboard-navigable with violet-500 focus rings on every interactive element

rules.name: The Earned Accent Rule
rules.body: Violet and azure are used to signal meaning: links, interactive states, focus, and emphasis. Not decoration.

rules.name: The Palette Warning
rules.body: The current void-black + violet/azure split is the first-order reflex palette for developer portfolios. The forthcoming craft palette rethink must break this reflex.

rules.name: The Label Language Rule
rules.body: Monospaced uppercase labels are reserved for structural metadata only. If a text element is prose, it does not get the mono label treatment.

rules.name: The Measure Rule
rules.body: Body copy containers cap at max-w-2xl (672px) in single-column contexts.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Every surface is flat at rest. Shadow appears only in response to state: hover on interactive cards, focus on buttons.

dos: Do use focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-violet-500 on every interactive element
Do preserve 128px between major page sections
Do use dl/dt/dd for key/value data relationships
Do use monospaced uppercase labels only for structural metadata
Do add aspect-ratio to media containers before lazy-loaded images
Do run a scene sentence before choosing any color strategy
donts: Don't use background-clip: text with a gradient. Gradient text on headlines is a hard ban.
Don't build stat card grids (big number, small mono label, gradient accent). Use prose or a ruled list instead.
Don't apply backdrop-blur to card components by default. The nav menu is the only intentional blur.
Don't use the purple/blue gradient + dark background palette for new surfaces without explicitly running the category-reflex check.
Don't use Space Grotesk or Inter for new work without reviewing alternatives. Both are on the reflex-reject list.
Don't render GitHub contribution graphs, language badge grids, or star counters on any surface.
Don't use identical card grids for more than one section. Vary the structure.
Don't add empty confidence metrics like '100% Compromiso'.
